title: Payment Arrangements — Computing the Regular Installment After a Re-aging Deferral
content:
When an installment of a plan under Payment Arrangements is re-aged by a deferral, the regular installment amount after the change is worked out as follows.

## Definition

The re-aged installment is the installment carrying the plan's most recent missed entry; when no missed entry stands on the plan, the schedule anchor installment stands in for the re-aged installment in the re-aged remainder and in the installments that follow it.

The re-aged remainder is that installment's amount less the installment payments applied to it and not returned (never less than zero): the regular installment amount, less the installment payments booked to that installment, plus any of those payments returned.

The term window is the type's largest number of days to the final installment plus the term tolling plus the good-faith allowance, counted in calendar days from the term window start; one period after the plan's current final installment is seven days later for a weekly plan, fourteen days later for a biweekly plan and the same day of the following month for a monthly plan.

The re-aged remainder is spread evenly over the installments that follow the re-aged installment: the regular installment after the change is the regular installment plus the re-aged remainder divided by the number of those installments, the share rounded up to the type's rounding unit. The term tolling and the good-faith allowance are 0 days and the term window starts on the plan's creation date.

The installments that follow the re-aged installment number the plan's installment count less the re-aged installment's number less one (taken as one where that comes to less than one). The amount is stated to the cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Most recent missed entry and its installment | The plan's installment history |
| Payments booked to, and returned from, that installment | The plan's installment history |
| Regular installment amount, installment count, schedule anchor installment | The plan record |
| Rounding unit | The arrangement type's product figure |

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

A monthly plan of 12 installments with a regular installment of 200.00, on a type whose rounding unit is 1.00. Its most recent missed entry is for installment 5, to which 60.00 was paid and nothing returned.

- Re-aged remainder: 200.00 less 60.00 is 140.00.
- Installments that follow installment 5: 12 less 5 less 1 is 6.
- Share: 140.00 divided by 6 is 23.33…, rounded up to 24.00.
- Regular installment after the change: 200.00 plus 24.00 is 224.00.
